''' Related NPCs: ''' | Various |} Crafted Armor is a mid-level [[Warrior]] specific armor set. == Rewards == {{Gear Set |Crafted Breastplate |Crafted Plate Boots |Crafted Vambraces |Crafted Gauntlets |Crafted Bracers |Crafted Greaves |Crafted Helm |Crafted Pauldron }} == Walkthrough == Talk to either [[Shakrn Meadowgreen]] (160, -2217) or [[Ulan Meadowgreen]] (126, -2177) in [[Southern Karana]]. * Shakrn: Vambraces, Boots, Gauntlets, Helmet * Ulan: Pauldron, Greaves, Bracer, Breastplate For each armor piece you'll need to collect the following items. ==[[Shakrn Meadowgreen]]== [[File:npc_shakrn_meadowgreen.png|thumb|right|Shakrn Meadowgreen]] {{CheckboxList}} '''{{:Crafted Vambraces}}''' * [[Fire Emerald]] (2) * [[Griffon Eye]] ([[Northern Karana]] - [[a Griffon]] (level 35), [[Grimfeather]] (lvl 37))
'''{{:Crafted Plate Boots}}''' * [[Sapphire]] (2) * [[Goblin Frost Totem]] ([[Permafrost]] - a Goblin Patriarch (lvl 27-33 mob))
'''{{:Crafted Gauntlets}}''' * [[Star Ruby]] (2) * [[Aviak Charm]] ([[Southern Karana]] - [[Aviak avocet]] (lvl 28-30 mob))
'''{{:Crafted Helm}}''' * [[Ruby]] * [[Goblin Fire Totem]] ([[Solusek's Eye]] (A) - [[Fire goblin shaman]] Lvl 24, [[inferno goblin shaman]] Lvl 28) ==[[Ulan Meadowgreen]]== [[File:npc_ulan_meadowgreen.png|thumb|right|Ulan Meadowgreen]] '''{{:Crafted Breastplate}}''' * [[Ruby]] (3) * [[Werewolf Talon]] ([[Mistmoore]] - [[A gypsy musician]], [[Western Karana]] - [[A Werewolf]] (lvl 28-31 mobs))
'''{{:Crafted Bracers}}''' * [[Sapphire]] * [[Bunch of Optic Nerves]] ([[Gorge of King Xorbb]] and [[Lower Guk]] - an evil eye (level 17-18 mob))
'''{{:Crafted Greaves}}''' * [[Star Ruby]] (2) * [[Dark Circlet]] ([[Najena]] - [[Trazdon]] (lvl 25 mob))
'''{{:Crafted Pauldron}}''' The runes below are dropped by [[an Evil Eye (Runnyeye)]] pre-revamp and [[an Evil Eye prisoner]] post-revamp. * [[Fire Emerald]] * [[Bottom of a Fractured Rune]] * [[Middle of a Fractured Rune]] * [[Top of a Fractured Rune]] [[Category:Quests]] [[Category:Southern Karana]] [[Category:Warrior Quests]]
